subject: Stan-based package installation error - only on Windows computers

messages.author: 4bcf82a01cf98f56
messages.subject: Stan-based package installation error - only on Windows computers
parts:
Hi Stan developers, 

Thanks always for your support and help. Thanks to help from Stan developers, I could precompile Stan models in the R package my lab released (hBayesDM: https://github.com/CCS-Lab/hBayesDM). To my knowledge, the latest version (v0.3.1) can be installed on Mac and Linux (at least Ubuntu) computers without a problem. But when I try to install the hBayesDM package on a Windows computer (with Rtools installed), I get the following error along with some warnings:

cc1plus.exe: out of memory allocating 8392703 bytes


I opened an issue on the hBayesDM GitHub repository (https://github.com/CCS-Lab/hBayesDM/issues/13). I would highly appreciate if a Stan developer can identify the problem and fix it. Thanks a lot and please let me know if you have any questions.

Best,
Young

on the GitHub issue.
